pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "The Pro plan costs $25/month billed monthly… drops… to $18/month billed yearly… includes 10M tokens per month… Bolt offers a free plan with 1M tokens per month… the Teams plan costs $30 per member per month"

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: 1M tokens per month with a daily limit

nl.tagline: Webapps en sites bouwen in de browser met een AI-agent
nl.description: Bolt.new van StackBlitz bouwt full-stack webapps in je browser op basis van een prompt, met een live preview en directe publicatie. Je betaalt in tokens: complexere wijzigingen kosten er meer.
bestFor: Makers die de code willen zien en aanpassen
limitations: Tokenverbruik loopt snel op bij grote projecten

en.tagline: Build web apps and sites in the browser with an AI agent
en.description: StackBlitz's Bolt.new builds full-stack web apps in your browser from a prompt, with live preview and instant deployment. You pay in tokens: more complex changes cost more.
bestFor: Makers who want to see and tweak the code
limitations: Token usage adds up quickly on large projects
